title: Evaluating Commercial AI Chatbots as News Intermediaries

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multiple-choice accuracy and analyzing source citation behavior across queries in six languages (English, French, Arabic, Hindi, Russian, Turkish) to measure performance disparities and Anglophone retrieval preference.

Comparing chatbot factual accuracy and error rates on questions derived from same-day BBC News reporting across six different geographic regional services (US & Canada, Afrique, Middle East/Arabic, India/Hindi, Russia, Turkey).
